DoorKind.description: How a link between maps is crossed: a door, or stairs, a ladder or a lift between floors.
DoorKind.title: DoorKind

MapTile.description: A tile on a given map: the village or an interior, or in side view a street or a floor.
MapTile.title: MapTile

description:
A link between two maps: taking it from either end tile puts you on the other one. A door
joins the village or a street (`outside`) and a building's ground floor (`inside`), or two
streets, with `outside` on the one whose id comes first alphabetically. Stairs, a ladder or a
lift join two floors' maps, `outside` the lower and `inside` the upper. No two links share an
end tile, so a lift serving three floors, or two flights meeting on a landing, has a separate
end tile on the middle floor for each link.

kind.description: How it's crossed. Left out for a door.

outside.description: The walkable tile in front of the building's door, the lower floor's end, or the end on the street whose id comes first.

inside.description: The mat just inside the interior's entrance, the upper floor's end, or the end on the other street.
